answer: Commit-reveal stops bulk fakes. An agent stakes 70 credits in the vault and seals a hash of one haven site plan. At the comet flash, the reveal goes to auditors, who replay the hash; a mismatch or reused haven site burns the stake. The kth reveal costs 35+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 staked, above a 40,000 pool. A rented reveal carries its owner's key; a second filing burns both. Honest agents pay 35 once and get it back.
